texto: For a possible condition, it is very common to use present in both parts: **Hvis jeg har tid, kommer jeg.** = If I have time, I go.

You can also use **vil** or **skal** in the main sentence if you want to express intention or plan. Do not use **ville** only as a brand of the future: it usually presents the result as hypothetical or courteous.
If it's a dream or something that's not going to happen, use preterito and **ville**: **Hvis jeg havde tid, ville jeg komme.** = If I had time, I would come.
Eye: **Hvis jeg vil** (if I want) is real. **Hvis jeg ville** (if you want) is imaginary.
You can put the verb at first and remove **hvis**: **Havde jeg tid, ville jeg komme.** = If I had time, I would come.
It is more formal and is noted in the written language.

frases.es: Si llueve mañana, me quedo en casa.
